theorem_results.scope: simple cubic bipartite incidence graph of girth>=10 containing a 10-cycle
theorem_results.hole_vertices: each is an induced claw center
theorem_results.implication_falsified: two-expansion plus odd-hole source geometry forces useful local attachment overlap or domination

novelty_delta: Girth>=10 alone forces a conflict C5 to have fifteen distinct external source ports and makes every hole vertex a claw center; the whole conflict graph is 6-regular with no closed-neighborhood domination. Hence NM-0027 two-expansion does not force the local overlap/domination hoped for by the next contraction route.
progress_claim: Closes expansion-to-local-overlap as a universal route and supplies an exact source-backed high-girth negative control. The finite Harries witness is deliberately marked low-nullity, so the next theorem must use additional filtered residual promises or long-range context.
reentry_policy: Do not infer useful local odd-hole attachment overlap from NM-0027 expansion or untouched cubic geometry. Harries is a low-nullity control, not the full residual. Any next theorem combining odd-hole geometry with high-nullity, phase-fail, or noncommuting promises requires PA-0025.
